posts.name: BlueHairedMeerkat
posts.cooked: He redirects the damage from the Shock Infantry, because he can reduce it to 2, but because the attack is then hitting the Banshee there's nothing reducing it any more, so it hits for 3.

posts.name: Reckless
posts.cooked:
phantaskippy:

Wait, how does Fixer redirect 3 damage, he can only redirect 2.  He reduces it to 2 with Pipewrench, then redirects it, he doesn't increase it because it isn't him dealing the damage, nor does Advanced mode reduce it.  He would just redirect 2 damage.

Damage reduced/taken to targets resets against different targets if an attack is redirected.  Mister Fixer reduces damage dealt to him by one.  If he were hit by an attack of three, reduced it by one, and redirected the two damage to Ambuscade, then he would deal Ambuscade three damage (assuming he didn't have DR).

Oh, well I've been playing that wrong.  Thanks for the correction.

So with Tempest's Shielding Winds, and Pipewrench Mr. Fixer could redirect a shot of five damage.  That exact situation would have won me a game, gah.  Guess I have a new "Most embarrassing rule failure" now.
